description: DRAFT in the temp namespace; may change without notice. Shared definitions for governed crossing records: the inline signature type, record references, and the substrate-crossing extensions. An AT Protocol binding of the seam:CrossingRecord vocabulary (https://jediwright.github.io/seam-stack/vocab/crossing-record/0.1#), which is the semantic contract.

signature.description: Inline signature per the ATProtocol Attestation Specification v1.0. Signs the CIDv1 (DAG-CBOR, sha2-256) of the record with `signatures` removed and a `$sig` object inserted, where `$sig` is this signature object minus `signature`, plus `repository` set to the record's `emittedBy` DID. Because `key` and `role` enter `$sig`, each signer's CID is distinct; every signer covers the same record content. ECDSA P-256 or K-256, low-S.
ECDSA signature over the CID bytes, low-S form.

key.description: Full DID verification method reference (did:...#fragment). A dedicated verification method is advised so key rotation does not orphan signatures.

recordRef.description: Reference to another crossing record. `recordId` is the record's substrate-independent identifier. `cid` is its link CID: the CIDv1 (DAG-CBOR, sha2-256) of the record with `signatures`, every `$type` key at any depth, `provenanceStatus`, `provenanceStatusBasis` and `supersededBy` removed, and no `$sig` inserted. A content address, not a signature or proof.

sourceLineageEntry.description: One granted input the crossed content was assembled from. Informational lineage; the binding digest is crossingIntent.authorizedContentDigest.

documentCID.description: Content address or heads of the input document at assembly.

crossingIntent.description: Instance extension for recordType crossing-intent (governanceEvent substrate-crossing). Emitted before the crossing act. Carries digests and references of what crosses, never the content.

sourceDocumentCID.description: Content address or heads of the source document at mint; backdating-detectability anchor, no verification claim.

authorizedContentDigest.description: Digest of the content authorized to cross, bound at grant time.

targetLexicon.description: Schema of the record in the target regime (AT Protocol crossings).

targetService.description: Service the crossing writes to (a PDS for AT Protocol).

regimeAcknowledgment.description: Declared acknowledgment; the gate checks presence, not authorship.

gateResult.description: A record of a blocked gate check is never published in any form (no commitment, no projection); it stays on the party's substrate.

crossingCompletion.description: Instance extension for recordType crossing-completion (governanceEvent substrate-crossing). Must be emitted whenever the emitter observes that the crossing act succeeded, including after crossingTimeoutHorizon; the intent is referenced by the record's chainReference.

targetAcceptedAt.description: When the target service accepted the write (a PDS for AT Protocol).
